title: ABAC Policy Decision Point Semantic Contract
description: Source-backed draft semantic contract for the abac policy decision point capability, derived from historical React evidence as lineage. Facets cite verified source-import manifest rows; proof is hermetic/runtime lineage and not fresh USF proof.
aiGuidance: Source-backed draft. Facets cite verified manifest source rows as lineage; proof is hermetic/stale and not current readiness. Do not treat as implementation authority or fresh proof; respect the hexagonal constraint in ADR 0005.

lifecycle.description: Read current policy, audit, set replacement; request evaluation is authorization-server-first with a static fail-closed fallback and step-up on insufficient auth.

stateModel.description: Each guarded route declares a resource, scope, and required permission; optional resource-policy records and decision results form the state.

permissions.description: Routes declare requiredPermission/resource/scope; policy writes sit behind tenant auth-settings; audit precedes mutation.

contracts.description: Resource-policy read/write plus per-route guard metadata consumed by the authorization pipeline.

validation.description: Unknown/unregistered resources degrade to static evaluation; an absent static policy denies; an injected policy may allow.

errorModel.description: policy_denied, insufficient_auth/step-up, and missing-token outcomes; fail-closed by default.

auditModel.description: Resource-policy mutations are audited before the adapter set; read-only authorization checks are logged, not per-request audited.

readinessModel.description: Ready for the local policy seam; authorization-server unavailability is an explicit non-decisive degradation with static fallback.

proof.description: Unit and runtime proof of the decision and policy chain. Demonstrated in React via hermetic/runtime proof lineage; fresh USF proof pending USF-101/USF-59.

uiSemanticDefinition.description: No verified UI source path in the manifest yet; author the UI semantic model before generation.
